profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ SS&C Technologies
profile.summary:
An Information Systems/Data Processing professional with 20+ years of experience, including project management,  application development, programming, operations experience, disaster recovery and DASD/Storage Management.  Skills in COBOL, DB2, IMS DB/DC, CICS, FOCUS and SAS as well as recent experience in using ETL tools and SQL.  Very responsible professional with good communication skills, quality oriented and an assertive team player.

Specialties: Relationship building, problem solving

positions.title: Applications Architect
positions.description: Key mainframe technical resource for the company’s strategic initiative to consolidate/convert from a legacy application that provides policy administration for 1.2 million policies.   In role as Applications Architect, was critical to the success of numerous conversions.    Assisted the  business analysts in writing test plans and scripts, and provided them with tools to verify their results.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Served as the lead systems analyst  responsible for  the LIPAS policy administration system.  Developed, tested, implemented numerous projects while functioning as senior technical resource.

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description: Was a team leader responsible for all programming enhancements and modifications in a RISC/6000 UNIX environment for legacy PLB applications and new C development, coordination, prioritization and scheduling for a team of four programmers.  Supported third party designed Warehouse Distribution Systems utilizing RF technology and barcoding in a Windows NT environment.  Analyzed business needs, prepared cost justifications,  designed enhancements, prepared business and technical specifications, obtained cost approvals and oversaw development, testing and installation.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Working in a COBOL/VSAM environment, analyzed business specifications, wrote technical specifications based on the business needs defined, coded, tested and implemented modifications and enhancements to complex insurance/annuities applications.  Was intensively involved in the timely resolution and debugging of production problems.   Functioned as Senior Systems Analyst in a team environment.  Was heavily involved with business analysts and client companies.  Saw numerous project through from conception to completion.

positions.title: Data Processing Associate III
positions.description: Responsible for the day-to-day management of DASD storage, ICF catalogs, backups and disaster recovery for dynamic, multi-system complexes.  Utilized IBM’s DFDSS and ICKDSF utilities to manipulate DASD.  Participated in a conversion to a System Managed Storage environment.  Used DFHSM to control DASD storage pools.   Participated in a joint team effort to consolidate operations and support to data centers in a logical control center.  Assisted in an effort which resulted in alleviating long-standing performance problems due to DASD fragmentation cycles.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Provided ad hoc programming support for U.S. Sprint’s Revenues department using COBOL and SAS programming languages. Provided programming and report design supporting their new Billing System.   Developed and coded report layouts using DB2 technology and SQL as well.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Provided all aspects of applications support for application systems in a COBOL IMS DB/DC environment.  Participated as a member of a design and implementation team for a major successful rewrite of all accounting systems.  Coded and tested parallel pilot systems using 4th generation languages.  Employed Arthur Anderson’s Structured Design Methodology for the analysis and design phases of all projects.
